video_title: 2026 Hornets Training Camp Media Availability: Coach Charles Lee

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Charles Lee praises the Hornets for their competitive spirit and growth during training camp.
quotes.excerpt: Our guys have come in with the right mindset, the right attitude to work
quotes.quote: It has been an amazing couple days of practice. I feel like our guys have come in with the right mindset, the right attitude to work individually as hard as they can to get better, but then also collectively. They have been pushing each other to a lot of different levels, I think with their physicality, with their vocal leadership, and ability to I feel like we have grown from the standpoint of being able to give feedback in the moment and then also receive it in a lot better way. And so it is really paying dividends out here on the court. Our guys have adjusted really well, and just like I felt yesterday the competitive spirit was good. I thought that it went to another level today when typically most people come in after that first day, you are sore, you are tired, and our guys did not make any excuses. They just tried to find a way to get better today, which was great.
quotes.social_post: Coach Charles Lee says the Hornets have come into training camp with the right mindset and attitude, noting that the team has grown in their ability to give and receive feedback.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Charles Lee discusses the challenge of balancing conditioning and teaching during training camp.
quotes.excerpt: our coaching staff has done a really good job of finding that balance
quotes.quote: The biggest part of it is not overloading them, I think mentally sometimes, because you do want a lot of this to be like they are getting themselves in game shape. And so really being mindful of how much information we are throwing at them every day. But it is really important too that we lay the foundation for all of our techniques and the communication of calls and tactics and stuff. So I think our coaching staff has done a really good job of finding that balance of getting them in and out of drills while also teaching them a lot of the basics and fundamentals that we want them to have.
quotes.social_post: Coach Charles Lee says the coaching staff is focused on finding the right balance between getting players in game shape and teaching the fundamentals during training camp.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Charles Lee explains the use of music and noise to simulate game-time focus.
quotes.excerpt: you got to find a way to focus on the things that we do control
quotes.quote: It was perfect at the end of the practice, just like at the end of the game. You have been going for a while, you are kind of tired, it has been a really physical game, and I think at a certain point between the music in the arena, whatever you might have personally going on with yourself, you got to find a way to focus on the things that we do control. And so tuning out some of the distractions in the arena and really focusing on what is important in the moment right now. What is this moment asking of me? And I thought the guys did a great job of banding together and really not letting the distractions take away from the ultimate focus, which is to win the game or win the drill.
quotes.social_post: Coach Charles Lee says he uses music and distractions during practice to help players learn to focus on what they can control, just like in a real game.
